source.toolchain: Go 1.26.8 with vendored modules; offline build and local file evaluation

scenarios.rule: selected current FileStore OSD metadata is incompatible with Reef
scenarios.input: caller-supplied selected current per-OSD metadata JSON object

scenarios.rule: selected IAM access-key json-diff policy filter is removed

scenarios.versionKind: CNI specification editions, not library releases

scenarios.rule: selected networking.x-k8s.io/v1alpha1 resources need explicit migration
an intended enabled OpenTelemetry HTTP/2 setting must remain explicitly enabled
scenarios.input: caller-declared complete native classic configuration with current-default and preservation declarations

scenarios.rule: legacy alerting cannot be explicitly enabled
interfaces with no or multiple bindings are rejected
selected legacy ConfigMap configuration is removed
scenarios.input: caller-selected ConfigMap or reviewed CR JSON

scenarios.rule: ASCII spaces in supplied server, cluster, or gateway names are rejected
scenarios.input: caller-supplied native JSON NATS configuration subset

scenarios.rule: enabled cloud-cost collection moves from provider-derived configuration to an explicitly selected cloud-integration file
scenarios.input: caller-declared complete source selection; file presence is declared, not observed

scenarios.rule: OIDC issuer and audience are required for complete effective configuration
scenarios.input: native effective-config JSON with explicit completeness
caller-selected complete native scrape_config YAML with resolved precedence

resultScope: Each result is limited to its named predicate, exact source contract, supplied local input, and caller-declared intent.
Unsupported, missing, ambiguous, incomplete, or unobserved facts remain UNKNOWN.
The checks do not establish whole-upgrade compatibility, cluster state, effective configuration, runtime behavior, delivery, backup completion, or data safety.
The tool reads local data and does not execute supplied source, workloads, plugins, or commands.
There is no official prebuilt binary, hosted feed, startup refresh, or automatic knowledge admission.

knowledgeUpdates.metadataOnly: Reviewed metadata may reuse existing canonical facts and admitted input formats.
knowledgeUpdates.cliBoundary: New fact types, engine behavior, or native input formats may require a CLI release.
knowledgeUpdates.replay: Historical local selections remain explicit and separately verifiable.

contribution.policy: Candidate evidence receives independent source, semantic, and maintainer review before publication.

historicalPreparation.note: The identifiers below describe an earlier private preparation checkout. They are not the current checkout, current tree, current inventory, or publication commit.
